james.5.p1.b1.text: Come now, you who are rich, weep and wail …

james.5.p1.b2.text: Your riches have rotted and moths have eaten your clothes. Your gold and silver are corroded. …

james.5.p1.b3.text: Look, the wages you withheld from the workmen who mowed your fields are crying out against you. The cries of the harvesters have reached the ears of the Lord of Hosts.

james.5.p1.b4.text: You have lived on earth in luxury and self-indulgence. …

james.5.p2.b1.text: Be patient, then, brothers, until the Lord’s coming. See how the farmer awaits the precious fruit of the soil—how patient he is for the fall and spring rains.

james.5.p2.b2.text: You, too, be patient and strengthen your hearts, because the Lord’s coming is near.

james.5.p2.b3.text: Do not complain about one another, brothers, so that you will not be judged.

james.5.p2.b4.text: Look, the Judge is standing at the door!

james.5.p3.b1.text: Brothers, as an example of patience in affliction, take the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.

james.5.p3.b2.text: … You have heard of Job’s perseverance

james.5.p3.b3.text: and have seen the outcome from the Lord. The Lord is full of compassion and mercy.

james.5.p3.b4.text: … Simply let your “Yes” be yes, and your “No,” no, so that you will not fall under judgment.

james.5.p4.b1.text: Is any one of you suffering? He should pray.

james.5.p4.b2.text: Is anyone cheerful? He should sing praises.

james.5.p4.b3.text: Is any one of you sick? He should call the elders of the church to pray over him and anoint him with oil in the name of the Lord.

james.5.p4.b4.text: Therefore confess your sins to each other and pray for each other so that you may be healed. The prayer of a righteous man has great power to prevail.

james.5.p5.b1.text: Elijah was a man just like us. He prayed earnestly that it would not rain, and it did not rain on the land for three and a half years.

james.5.p5.b2.text: Again he prayed, and the heavens gave rain, and the earth yielded its crops.

james.5.p5.b3.text: My brothers, if one of you should wander from the truth and someone should bring him back,

james.5.p5.b4.text: consider this: Whoever turns a sinner from the error of his way will save his soul from death and cover over a multitude of sins.
